questions.cardDe: Wie wird in Frankreich ein Beamter genannt: serveur, fonctionnaire oder domestique?
questions.de: Wie wird in Frankreich ein Beamter genannt?
questions.en: What is a civil servant (Beamter) called in France?

timeline.labelEn: France adopts the republican general statute of its civil servants (statut général des fonctionnaires)
timeline.labelDe: Frankreich verabschiedet das republikanische Beamtenstatut (statut général des fonctionnaires)

questions.notes: Multiple-choice card reworked into an open question. Timeline: law of 19 October 1946 (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fonction_publique_fran%C3%A7aise); Vichy's 1941 statute was annulled at the Liberation.

questions.cardDe: Was enthielt die in den 1940er-Jahren produzierte Zahnpasta Doramad: radioaktives Radium, zermahlene ägyptische Mumien oder Goldstaub?
questions.de: Welchen radioaktiven Stoff enthielt die in den 1940er-Jahren produzierte Zahnpasta Doramad?
questions.en: Which radioactive substance did Doramad toothpaste, produced in the 1940s, contain?

timeline.labelEn: Doramad, the Auer company's radioactive toothpaste, is sold in Germany
timeline.labelDe: Doramad, die radioaktive Zahnpasta der Berliner Auergesellschaft, wird in Deutschland verkauft

questions.notes: Multiple-choice card reworked. Wikipedia says Doramad contained Thorium X, the historical name of the radium isotope Ra-224 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isotopes_of_radium), so the card's 'radioaktives Radium' is right; accept Radium too. It was made in the first half of the 20th century (in use by 1927), not only in the 1940s.

questions.cardDe: Wie heißt der Autor, dessen Buch anfänglich unter dem Namen Dino Park veröffentlicht wude?
questions.de: Wie heißt der Autor, dessen Buch anfänglich unter dem Namen Dino Park veröffentlicht wurde?
questions.en: Who is the author whose book was initially published (in German) under the title Dino Park?

timeline.labelEn: Michael Crichton's novel Jurassic Park is published (German edition DinoPark, 1991)
timeline.labelDe: Michael Crichtons Roman Jurassic Park erscheint (deutsche Ausgabe DinoPark, 1991)

questions.notes: The card misprints 'wurde' as 'wude'; cardDe keeps the misprint, de corrects it (reworked only for that typo fix; the question was already open). DinoPark is the German title (1991) of Jurassic Park (1990); later German editions use the English title.

questions.cardDe: Welche Augenfarbe, die sich von der im Sommer unterscheidet, haben Rentiere im Winter?
questions.de: Welche Augenfarbe, die sich von der im Sommer unterscheidet, haben Rentiere im Winter?
questions.en: What eye colour, different from the one in summer, do reindeer have in winter?

timeline.labelEn: Study shows Arctic reindeer eyes' tapetum turns from gold in summer to blue in winter
timeline.labelDe: Studie zeigt: Das Tapetum der Augen arktischer Rentiere färbt sich von Gold im Sommer zu Blau im Winter

questions.notes: It is the tapetum lucidum (the reflective layer behind the retina) that turns blue in winter; gold in summer.

questions.en: Which Grand Slam tournament did Boris Becker never win as a player, but did win as Novak Djokovic's coach?

timeline.labelEn: Novak Djokovic, coached by Boris Becker, wins his first French Open and completes the career Grand Slam
timeline.labelDe: Novak Đoković gewinnt mit Trainer Boris Becker erstmals die French Open und vollendet den Karriere-Grand-Slam

questions.notes: Multiple-choice card reworked. Becker never won the French Open (no clay title at all); Djokovic won it in 2016 under him (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2016_French_Open_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_singles).
